Name: Maggs Immersive Sam Spicy Expansion Dialogue and Events
Author: MaggPlays
Description:
Follow me on the socials for current updates, what I'm planning, or just general shenanigans! [url=https://www.tumblr.com/blog/maggplays]Tumblr[/url] | [url=https://bsky.app/profile/maggplays.bsky.social]Bluesky[/url]
My mods are free and always will be free, but if you enjoy them, consider buying me a coffee on [url=https://ko-fi.com/maggplays]Ko-fi[/url]!

This expansion pack adds the spicy and mature (extra spicy) content to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/41190]Maggs Immersive Sam Romance Core[/url]. This content can be fairly steamy, but is not yandere or crass.

[b]DISCLAIMER FOR WRITING STYLE
[/b]The dialogue in this mod is written informally and according to common speech patterns, so it is NOT always grammatically correct. Words may be dropped, conjunctions skipped, and improper words used. Formal grammar is not natural speech and sounds forced and flat when used for dialogue.

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/201103991-1768198861.png[/img]﻿
Sam is a very expressive and handsy man! Get ready for sexual tension that strings you along until the confession, along with choices that change events, and some very "unfortunate" mishaps... Sam has some crazy luck!
[list]
[*]Some event choices will affect future event dialogue.[/*]
[*]Includes a Mature option that adds a bit more to the spicy content (let's face it, it's basically cozy smut)[/*]
[*]Sleepover and Pillowtalk event series. (Disabled for poly players due to issues with multi-spouse game changes and different farmhouse structures).[/*]
[*]Good Morning and Sleepover series include a custom map for the farmhouse kitchen and bedroom. Configuration options available in the Core mod to use the vanilla farmhouse kitchen.[/*]
[/list]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/201103991-1768199233.png[/img]

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/201103991-1768199442.png[/img]﻿
This mod uses Spiderbutton's Cross-Mod Compatibility Tokens so you don't have to enter configuration options twice, most of the options are in the Immersive Sam Core configuration menu. 
A few additional options are in this mod, most notably the Mature Content option. Please go to the configuration menu to turn this off for Spicy-only content.

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/201103991-1768199337.png[/img]
Do NOT copy and re-post this mod elsewhere without requesting permission. Copyright is a thing. This mod is 100% my own work.

[b]Translation: [/b]This mod includes an i18n file, so it is translation-friendly. You do not need to ask for permission to translate, just make sure to add this mod as a dependency so people can find the translation.
